sourceHierarchy.blueprint: Governing product/entitlement/certification architecture; build target, not production authorization (P8,P30).
sourceHierarchy.catalog: Portfolio/planning inventory and entitlement mapping; does not specify full formulas/input modes and does not establish live state (P34,P979).

historicalMissingBlueprintDisposition: STALE_AVAILABILITY_CLAIM: native full Blueprint is available and SHA256 recorded here. Earlier missing-attachment/UNKNOWN canonical-scope availability statements must be superseded only for source availability. This does not approve per-ID scope, mapping, source applicability, qualified review, numerical/browser acceptance or publication.

sharedRequirements.requirement: Stable canonical ID/slug; typed inputs/units/defaults/validation/precision/classification; explicit rounding, risk metadata and immutable technical revision; deterministic offline compute with no plan formula forks.
Structured result/presentation contract; primary result, useful interpretation, assumptions/warnings/methodology and related journey; optional result arrays populated only where meaningful.
Free complete accurate core; central entitlement resolution; identical authoritative results and safety interpretation for identical accuracy-required inputs across plans.

Conditional features: 3–6 cards when meaningful; useful Free visualization when beneficial; schedules where mathematically useful; reverse where supported; scenarios/sensitivity where decision-relevant. Applicability must be declared, not blanket waived or blindly imposed.

Pro advanced analysis/reverse/scenarios/sensitivity, persistence, CSV/JSON/PDF and richer explanation; Business team/client/builder/branding/embed/API/batch/webhooks/governance capabilities governed centrally. Preserve catalog row differences and meaningful applicability.

Formula unit/golden/boundary tests and explicit rounding; forward verification of reverse solves; chart/table/scenario/export reconciliation; entitlement, editorial, UX, accessibility, performance, SEO and security evidence; regulatory/specialist review where applicable.
Versioned saved work/history/scenario assumptions; historical results not silently rewritten by material formula/rule changes.
Draft→Review→Certified→Published Final; certification and publication separate, fail-closed; catalog planning status never proves lifecycle.
